name: pi-anchored-tool-for-dspro
description: Pi extension that anchors a target model's first request to a minimal tool catalog (shell + read), then restores the full catalog after the first tool call. For DeepSeek V4 Pro and other models that condition on the API-visible tool list (Standard/PTC 91/
